files.content:
name: DevSecOps CI/CD Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 */12 * * *'

permissions:
  id-token: write
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write
  security-events: write

jobs:
  security-scans:
    name: Shift-Left Security Scans
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4

      - name: Gitleaks Secret Scanning
        uses: gitleaks/gitleaks-action@dcedce43c6f43de0b836d1fe38946645c9c638dc # v2
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: TFSec Core Azure Infrastructure Scan
        uses: aquasecurity/tfsec-action@b466648d6e39e7c75324f25d83891162a721f2d6 # v1.0.3
        with:
          soft_fail: false
          additional_args: --minimum-severity HIGH
          working_directory: ./terraform

      - name: TFSec Honeypot Infrastructure Scan
        uses: aquasecurity/tfsec-action@b466648d6e39e7c75324f25d83891162a721f2d6 # v1.0.3
        with:
          soft_fail: false
          additional_args: --minimum-severity HIGH
          working_directory: ./terraform-honeypot

      - name: TFSec SOAR Infrastructure Scan
        uses: aquasecurity/tfsec-action@b466648d6e39e7c75324f25d83891162a721f2d6 # v1.0.3
        with:
          soft_fail: false
          additional_args: --minimum-severity HIGH
          working_directory: ./terraform-soar

      - name: TFSec AWS Connector Scan
        uses: aquasecurity/tfsec-action@b466648d6e39e7c75324f25d83891162a721f2d6 # v1.0.3
        with:
          soft_fail: false
          additional_args: --minimum-severity HIGH
          working_directory: ./terraform-aws-connector

      - name: TFSec Azure Policy Module Scan
        uses: aquasecurity/tfsec-action@b466648d6e39e7c75324f25d83891162a721f2d6 # v1.0.3
        with:
          soft_fail: false
          additional_args: --minimum-severity HIGH
          working_directory: ./terraform-policy

      - name: Trivy Filesystem Scan
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@6c175e9c4083a92bbca2f9724c8a5e33bc2d97a5 # v0.30.0
        with:
          scan-type: 'fs'
          ignore-unfixed: true
          format: 'sarif'
          output: 'trivy-fs.sarif'
          severity: 'CRITICAL,HIGH'

      - name: Trivy IaC / Config Scan
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@6c175e9c4083a92bbca2f9724c8a5e33bc2d97a5 # v0.30.0
        with:
          scan-type: 'config'
          format: 'sarif'
          output: 'trivy-config.sarif'
          severity: 'CRITICAL,HIGH,MEDIUM'

      - name: Publish Trivy dependency findings
        if: always()
        uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@fee9466b8957867761f2d78f922ab084e3e2dd17 # v3
        with:
          sarif_file: 'trivy-fs.sarif'
          category: trivy-fs

      - name: Publish Trivy IaC findings
        if: always()
        uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@fee9466b8957867761f2d78f922ab084e3e2dd17 # v3
        with:
          sarif_file: 'trivy-config.sarif'
          category: trivy-config

  codeql-analysis:
    name: CodeQL Static Analysis
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4

      - name: Initialize CodeQL
        uses: github/codeql-action/init@fee9466b8957867761f2d78f922ab084e3e2dd17 # v3
        with:
          languages: javascript-typescript,python,go

      - name: Autobuild
        uses: github/codeql-action/autobuild@fee9466b8957867761f2d78f922ab084e3e2dd17 # v3

      - name: Perform CodeQL Analysis
        uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@fee9466b8957867761f2d78f922ab084e3e2dd17 # v3

  terraform-validate:
    name: Terraform Format & Validate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        module:
          - terraform
          - terraform-honeypot
          - terraform-soar
          - terraform-aws-connector
          - terraform-policy
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4

      - name: Setup Terraform
        uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@b9cd54a3c349d3f38e8881555d616ced269862dd # v3
        with:
          terraform_version: '1.5.0'

      - name: Terraform fmt
        working-directory: ./${{ matrix.module }}
        run: terraform fmt -check

      - name: Terraform init
        working-directory: ./${{ matrix.module }}
        run: terraform init -backend=false

      - name: Terraform validate
        working-directory: ./${{ matrix.module }}
        run: terraform validate

  go-tests:
    name: Go Deployer Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.23'
          cache-dependency-path: src-cli/go.sum

      - name: gofmt check
        working-directory: ./src-cli
        run: |
          test -z "$(gofmt -l .)"

      - name: go vet
        working-directory: ./src-cli
        run: go vet ./...

      - name: go test
        working-directory: ./src-cli
        run: go test ./...

      - name: Validate YAML deployer mapping
        working-directory: ./src-cli
        run: go run . -dir ../sentinel-detection-pack/rules-yaml -dry-run -validate-json -output ../go-validation-report.json

      - name: Upload Go validation report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: go-deployer-validation-report
          path: go-validation-report.json
          retention-days: 14

  ui-build:
    name: PrimeReact UI Build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: sentinel-detection-pack/ui/package-lock.json

      - name: Install UI dependencies
        working-directory: ./sentinel-detection-pack/ui
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts

      - name: Build UI
        working-directory: ./sentinel-detection-pack/ui
        run: npm run build

      - name: Upload UI evidence data
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: ui-evidence-data
          path: |
            sentinel-detection-pack/ui/src/data/evidenceCatalog.js
            sentinel-detection-pack/ui/src/data/projectFacts.js
            sentinel-detection-pack/ui/src/data/reviewerJourney.js
          retention-days: 14

  validate-and-build:
    name: Validate & Bundle Rules
    needs:
      - security-scans
      - terraform-validate
      - go-tests
      - ui-build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: pip install pyyaml

      - name: Validate Sentinel Rules
        run: |
          chmod +x ./scripts/validate-rules.sh
          ./scripts/validate-rules.sh --check-samples

      - name: Detection metadata and sample validation
        run: python scripts/test-detections.py --output detection-validation-report.json

      - name: Bundle Detection Rules
        run: |
          chmod +x ./scripts/bundle-rules.sh
          ./scripts/bundle-rules.sh

      - name: Upload Detection Artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: sentinel-detection-artifacts
          path: |
            sentinel-detection-pack/bundles/
            detection-validation-report.json
            docs/detection-engineering/detection-validation-report.json
          retention-days: 14

  detection-assertion:
    name: Detection Assertion Demo
    needs: validate-and-build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Run local/mock detection assertion
        run: python scripts/assert-detection.py

  threat-intel-ingestion:
    name: Threat Intelligence Demo Ingestion
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Run Threat Intelligence Demo Pipeline
        run: python scripts/threat-intel-ingest.py

  deploy-to-sentinel:
    name: Deploy Sentinel Lab Rules
    needs:
      - validate-and-build
      - detection-assertion
      - codeql-analysis
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name == 'push'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4

      - name: Download Detection Artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          name: sentinel-detection-artifacts
          path: bundles/

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.23'

      - name: Azure Login (OIDC federated credential)
        uses: azure/login@1384c340ab2dda50fed2bee3041d1d87018aa5e8 # v2
        with:
          client-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
          tenant-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
          subscription-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}

      - name: Deploy Detection Rules to Sentinel (Go CLI)
        working-directory: ./src-cli
        env:
          AZURE_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
          AZURE_TENANT_ID: ${{ secrets.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
          AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID: ${{ secrets.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}
          ARM_USE_OIDC: 'true'
        run: |
          go build -o sentinel-deployer .
          ./sentinel-deployer \
            -sub "${{ secrets.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}" \
            -rg "${{ secrets.SENTINEL_RESOURCE_GROUP }}" \
            -workspace "${{ secrets.SENTINEL_WORKSPACE_NAME }}" \
            -dir ../sentinel-detection-pack/rules-yaml \
            -apply

files.deploys: Nightly terraform plan -detailed-exitcode against remote state; opens an incident issue on drift.
files.content:
name: Nightly IaC Drift Detection

# Detects out-of-band ("ClickOps") changes to the live Azure environment by running a
# read-only `terraform plan` against remote state every night and opening a tracked
# incident issue when reality diverges from the committed configuration.
#
# Required repo configuration:
#   secrets: AZURE_CLIENT_ID, AZURE_TENANT_ID, AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID  (OIDC federated)
#            TFSTATE_RG, TFSTATE_STORAGE_ACCOUNT, TFSTATE_CONTAINER   (azurerm backend)

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  id-token: write
  contents: read
  issues: write

jobs:
  detect-drift:
    name: Terraform Drift Check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4

      - name: Setup Terraform
        uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@b9cd54a3c349d3f38e8881555d616ced269862dd # v3
        with:
          terraform_version: "1.5.0"

      - name: Azure Login (OIDC federated credential)
        uses: azure/login@1384c340ab2dda50fed2bee3041d1d87018aa5e8 # v2
        with:
          client-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
          tenant-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
          subscription-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}

      - name: Terraform Init (remote azurerm backend)
        working-directory: ./terraform
        env:
          ARM_USE_OIDC: "true"
          ARM_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
          ARM_TENANT_ID: ${{ secrets.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
          ARM_SUBSCRIPTION_ID: ${{ secrets.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}
        run: |
          terraform init \
            -backend-config="resource_group_name=${{ secrets.TFSTATE_RG }}" \
            -backend-config="storage_account_name=${{ secrets.TFSTATE_STORAGE_ACCOUNT }}" \
            -backend-config="container_name=${{ secrets.TFSTATE_CONTAINER }}" \
            -backend-config="key=sentinel-core.tfstate"

      # -detailed-exitcode: 0 = no changes, 1 = error, 2 = drift (plan has changes).
      - name: Terraform Plan (detailed exit code)
        id: plan
        working-directory: ./terraform
        env:
          ARM_USE_OIDC: "true"
          ARM_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
          ARM_TENANT_ID: ${{ secrets.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
          ARM_SUBSCRIPTION_ID: ${{ secrets.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}
        run: |
          set +e
          terraform plan -detailed-exitcode -input=false -no-color -out=tfplan
          code=$?
          set -e
          echo "exit_code=$code" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          if [ "$code" = "2" ]; then
            echo "drift_detected=true" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
            terraform show -no-color tfplan | head -c 60000 > drift-summary.txt
          elif [ "$code" = "1" ]; then
            echo "Terraform plan errored." >&2
            exit 1
          else
            echo "drift_detected=false" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          fi

      - name: Create GitHub Issue on Drift
        if: env.drift_detected == 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@f28e40c7f34bde8b3046d885e986cb6290c5673b # v7
        with:
          script: |
            const fs = require('fs');
            let summary = 'See workflow logs for the full plan.';
            try { summary = fs.readFileSync('terraform/drift-summary.txt', 'utf8'); } catch (e) {}
            await github.rest.issues.create({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              title: `URGENT: Infrastructure drift detected (${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)})`,
              body: [
                'Terraform detected changes between the committed configuration and the live Azure environment.',
                'This usually means a manual ("ClickOps") change in the portal that is not tracked in Git.',
                '',
                'Reconcile by either reverting the manual change or codifying it in Terraform.',
                '',
                '<details><summary>Plan summary</summary>',
                '',
                '```',
                summary,
                '```',
                '</details>',
              ].join('\n'),
              labels: ["security", "drift", "incident"],
            });

files.content:
import logging
import time

try:
    from azure.identity import DefaultAzureCredential  # noqa: F401
    from azure.mgmt.securityinsight import SecurityInsights  # noqa: F401
except ImportError:
    DefaultAzureCredential = None
    SecurityInsights = None

# Continuous Detection Validation (CDV) Engine.
# Asserts that simulated attacks actually trigger Sentinel alerts. Fails CI/CD if they do not.

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s")


def verify_alert_fired(subscription_id, resource_group, workspace_name, expected_technique):
    logging.info("Authenticating via Azure OIDC to verify MITRE Technique: %s", expected_technique)

    # In a real CI/CD run, this uses the pipeline's Azure credentials:
    # credential = DefaultAzureCredential()
    # client = SecurityInsights(credential, subscription_id)
    if DefaultAzureCredential is None or SecurityInsights is None:
        logging.info("Azure SDK packages are not installed; running portfolio-safe mocked Sentinel assertion.")

    timeout_mins = 5
    poll_interval = 30

    logging.info("Polling Sentinel Incidents API every %ss for %s minutes.", poll_interval, timeout_mins)

    for index in range(int((timeout_mins * 60) / poll_interval)):
        # Mocking the API response for portfolio demonstration.
        # response = client.incidents.list(resource_group, workspace_name)
        time.sleep(1)

        # Simulate finding the alert on the third poll.
        if index == 2:
            logging.info("[SUCCESS] Alert found mapping to %s.", expected_technique)
            logging.info("Detection-as-Code Assertion Passed.")
            return True

        logging.info("Alert not yet populated in SIEM. Retrying.")

    logging.error("[FATAL] No alert triggered for %s within %s minutes.", expected_technique, timeout_mins)
    logging.error("The detection rule is either broken or the data source is down.")
    raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    verify_alert_fired("sub-123", "rg-secops", "law-sentinel", "T1059.001")

import logging

# Configures the Threat Intel API ingestion pipeline.
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s")
OTX_URL = "https://otx.alienvault.com/api/v1/indicators/export"


def fetch_and_normalize_iocs():
    logging.info("Initiating Threat Intel Fetch Pipeline from %s", OTX_URL)
    # In a real scenario, this reaches out to OTX/MISP.
    # For demo purposes, we simulate the normalized STIX/TAXII payload.
    mock_iocs = [
        {"indicator": "185.153.196.22", "type": "ipv4-addr", "threat_actor": "APT29"},
        {"indicator": "b2b4ceb7752b1b11b5df9d273295c5eb", "type": "file:hashes.'MD5'", "malware": "Ransomware.Ryuk"},
    ]
    logging.info("Successfully normalized %s indicators.", len(mock_iocs))
    return mock_iocs


def push_to_sentinel(iocs):
    # This function uses the Azure Identity SDK in production to authenticate
    # and push to the Microsoft.SecurityInsights threatIntelligence API endpoint.
    logging.info("Authenticating via Azure DefaultCredential (zero-trust).")
    logging.info("Streaming indicators to Azure Sentinel Threat Intelligence Data Connector.")

    for ioc in iocs:
        logging.info("[SUCCESS] Ingested IOC: %s | Tags: %s", ioc["indicator"], ioc.get("threat_actor", ioc.get("malware")))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    indicators = fetch_and_normalize_iocs()
    push_to_sentinel(indicators)
    print("TI Ingestion Pipeline Completed Successfully.")
